about: Techniques and passives of the 26 summonable launch heroines: S1, S2, S3, and the level 30 and level 50 passives.

records.name: Rising Floret Cut
records.text: Two rising cuts on one enemy for 50% ATK each, ignoring 20% of its Defense.

records.name: Sword Orchid Ladder
records.text: A climbing thrust hits one enemy for 140% ATK, ignoring 30% of its Defense. She gains Sword Intent for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and Rising Floret Cut is ready again.

records.name: Thousand Florets, One Edge
records.text: Seven strikes climb the blade on one enemy for 32% ATK, each 10% stronger than the last (291% ATK in all).

empower.text: +35% damage and Body Shatter for 2 turns before the first strike.

records.name: Climbing Blooms
records.text: Each technique she casts in a turn gives her later ones that turn +15% damage, up to +45%.

records.name: Metal Carries Water
records.text: Her casts that extend a Harmony chain gain +25% critical chance.

records.name: Valley Wind Cut
records.text: A wind-edged cut hits one enemy for 100% ATK, with a 35% chance to remove one buff.

records.name: Empty Valley Orchid
records.text: One clean thrust for 140% ATK, +30% if the enemy has no buffs. She gains Wind Step for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and every buff on the target is removed before the thrust.

records.name: Gentleman's Verdict
records.text: Removes two buffs from one enemy, then three verdict strikes for 95% ATK each, +15% for each buff removed.

empower.text: +35% damage and Sealed Meridians for 1 turn.

records.name: Fragrance on the Wind
records.text: +15 Haste.

records.name: Accompanying Wind
records.text: Once per turn, when an ally's single-target technique hits an enemy, she follows up on it for 60% ATK.

records.name: Seed-Scatter Slash
records.text: Slash one enemy for 100% ATK. 50% chance of 1 Sword Wound stack for 2 turns.

records.name: Pomegranate Skirt Whirl
records.text: A whirling skirt of blades hits every enemy for 70% ATK and adds 1 Sword Wound stack for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and a second Sword Wound stack.

records.name: Thousand Seeds Burst
records.text: Cleaves one enemy for 200% ATK, then every Sword Wound stack on it bursts for 30% ATK.

empower.text: +35% damage and the burst sprays every other enemy for 50% ATK and 1 Sword Wound stack.

records.name: Red as May Fire
records.text: Enemies carrying Sword Wound count as burning for every ally's bonuses against Fire Poison.

records.name: Many Seeds
records.text: When an enemy with Sword Wound falls, its stacks pass to the healthiest enemy.

records.name: Drowsy Cleave
records.text: A slow, heavy swing hits one enemy for 105% ATK.

records.name: Stone Pillow Smash
records.text: Brings her stone greatsword down on one enemy for 140% ATK and Body Shatters it for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and Soul Shock for 1 turn.

records.name: The Crabapple Wakes
records.text: One wide-awake swing for 260% ATK, +30% against Body Shattered enemies.

empower.text: +35% damage and her yawn puts the healthiest other enemy into Lotus Dream for 1 turn.

records.name: Rude Awakening
records.text: When she is hit, her next technique deals 20% more damage.

records.name: Candles for the Sleeping Flower
records.text: Her techniques deal 20% more damage to enemies under Lotus Dream, Soul Shock or Frost Seal.

records.name: Magnolia Palm
records.text: A palm strike hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 40% chance to Provoke it for 1 turn.

records.name: Golden Bell Shield
records.text: She takes no damage for 1 turn (Golden Bell) and Provokes every enemy for 1 turn.

empower.text: Every ally also gains Iron Body for 1 turn.

records.name: Bodhi Wall of Jade Magnolia
records.text: Magnolia petals strike every enemy for 80% ATK; every ally gains a Spirit Shield worth 12% of her max Health for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and shield, and Clear Heart for every ally for 1 turn.

records.name: Iron Root
records.text: +20% Defense.

records.name: Bodhi Bell
records.text: Once per turn, when she is hit, she counterattacks for 60% ATK.

records.name: Coiling Vine
records.text: A whipping vine hits one enemy for 90% ATK. 35% chance to Entangle it for 1 turn.

records.name: Violet Canopy
records.text: Vines lash every enemy for 50% ATK with a 50% chance to Entangle for 1 turn. She gains Thorn Lotus for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and every enemy is Provoked for 1 turn.

records.name: Thousand-Year Embrace
records.text: She Provokes every enemy for 1 turn and gains Iron Body and Thorn Lotus for 2 turns; every ally gains Lotus Dew for 2 turns.

empower.text: Every enemy is also Entangled for 1 turn.

records.name: Clinging Vine
records.text: The allies beside her take 10% less damage.

records.name: Serpent Coil
records.text: An enemy that hits her has a 30% chance to be Entangled for 1 turn.

records.name: Tea-Mist Palm
records.text: A steaming palm hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 30% chance of Mist Veil for 1 turn.

records.name: Winter Camellia Guard
records.text: She Provokes every enemy for 1 turn and gains Iron Body for 2 turns.

empower.text: She also gains a Spirit Shield worth 12% of her max Health for 2 turns.

records.name: Whole-Bloom Fall
records.text: Every ally gains a Spirit Shield worth 12% of her max Health for 2 turns, and tea mist gives every enemy Mist Veil for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% shield and Lotus Dew for every ally for 2 turns.

records.name: Snowbound Blossom
records.text: +30% Defense while she is below half health.

records.name: Falls Whole
records.text: When she falls, every ally gains a Spirit Shield worth 15% of her max Health for 2 turns.

records.name: Cuckoo's Cry
records.text: A ringing strike hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 40% chance to Provoke it for 1 turn.

records.name: Weeping Blood Bloom
records.text: She cries out, Provoking every enemy for 1 turn, and gains Thorn Lotus for 2 turns.

empower.text: She also gains Iron Body for 2 turns.

records.name: Mountains Ablaze in Red
records.text: Azalea fire sweeps every enemy for 90% ATK and applies Fire Poison for 2 turns. She gains Iron Body for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and every ally gains a Spirit Shield worth 15% of her max Health for 2 turns.

records.name: Tears Like Fire
records.text: An enemy that hits her has a 25% chance to catch Fire Poison for 1 turn.

records.name: Cry Until It Bleeds
records.text: Her damage rises by 1% for every 2% of health she is missing.

records.name: Imperial Fan Strike
records.text: A sweep of her jade fan hits one enemy for 90% ATK; the most injured ally gains a Spirit Shield worth 6% of her max Health for 1 turn.

records.name: Unbowed Before the Empress
records.text: She Provokes every enemy for 1 turn, every ally gains Clear Heart for 1 turn, and she gains Iron Body for 2 turns.

empower.text: Every debuff on every ally is removed first.

records.name: Queen of a Hundred Flowers
records.text: Every ally gains a Spirit Shield worth 15% of her max Health for 2 turns, and the team gains 3 Spirit Qi.

empower.text: +35% shield and the most injured ally gains Golden Bell for 1 turn.

records.name: National Beauty, Heavenly Fragrance
records.text: While she stands, every ally takes 10% less damage.

records.name: Wealth and Rank
records.text: Once per turn, when she is hit, the team gains 1 Spirit Qi.

records.name: Pear Petal Needles
records.text: Four needles hit one enemy for 25% ATK each.

records.name: Rainstorm Pear Blossom Needles
records.text: A storm of needles hits every enemy three times for 24% ATK each.

empower.text: +35% damage and each hit adds a Sword Wound stack for 2 turns.

records.name: A Thousand Trees in One Night
records.text: Twelve needles hit one enemy for 23% ATK each, +40% against Shattered enemies: enough hits to break a whole Qi shield.

empower.text: +35% damage, then she gains Shadow Veil for 1 turn and Wind Step for 2 turns.

records.name: Hidden Weapon Case
records.text: Each of her multi-hit techniques breaks 1 extra Qi shield segment.

records.name: Snow on Ten Thousand Branches
records.text: When she Shatters a boss's Qi shield, all her techniques come 1 turn closer.

records.name: Kite-Tail Darts
records.text: Two darts hit one enemy for 50% ATK each. 25% chance of Mist Veil for 1 turn.

records.name: Blue Kite Vanishing
records.text: She strikes one enemy for 130% ATK and vanishes into the mist: Shadow Veil for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and Kite-Tail Darts is ready again.

records.name: Rainbow Messenger
records.text: Three rainbow strikes hit one enemy for 90% ATK each and apply Mist Veil for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and every ally's charging S2 comes 1 turn closer.

records.name: Unseen Courier
records.text: She starts each battle with Shadow Veil for 1 turn.

records.name: Letters on the Wind
records.text: +25% damage while she has Shadow Veil.

records.name: Thorned Kiss
records.text: Two thorned strikes on one enemy for 50% ATK each; each has a 25% chance to add a Heart Demon stack.

records.name: Fox-Fire Rose
records.text: Fox-fire petals hit every enemy for 70% ATK with a 60% chance to add a Heart Demon stack. She gains Thorn Lotus for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and every enemy surely gains a Heart Demon stack.

records.name: Rose of the Crimson Moon
records.text: Three strikes on one enemy for 95% ATK each, +30% against Heart Demon, then 2 Heart Demon stacks. At 3 stacks a charmed enemy attacks its own ally.

empower.text: +35% damage and every enemy with Heart Demon catches Fire Poison for 2 turns.

records.name: Every Rose Has Thorns
records.text: An enemy that hits her gains a Heart Demon stack.

records.name: Nine-Tailed Allure
records.text: Once per turn, when Heart Demon turns an enemy against its ally, all her techniques come 1 turn closer.

records.name: Bamboo-Leaf Fang
records.text: Two fang strikes on one enemy for 50% ATK each. 40% chance of Gu Venom for 2 turns.

records.name: Sweet Oleander Mist
records.text: Sweet poison mist hits every enemy for 65% ATK and applies Gu Venom for 2 turns, with a 50% chance of Withering for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and Gu Venom lasts 3 turns.

records.name: Every Petal a Poison
records.text: Two strikes on one enemy for 130% ATK each, +10% for each debuff it carries; then its Gu Venom deals all its remaining damage at once.

empower.text: +35% damage and every debuff on the target spreads to every other enemy.

records.name: Viper's Patience
records.text: Her damage rises by 8% for each debuff on the target, up to +40%.

records.name: Poison Without Order
records.text: Each cast that breaks a chain gives her +10% damage for the turn, up to +40%.

records.name: White Jasmine Seal
records.text: A white talisman hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 30% chance of Karmic Mark for 1 turn.

records.name: Scripture of Silence
records.text: A sealing scripture hits one enemy for 110% ATK and Seals its Meridians for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and Karmic Mark for 2 turns.

records.name: Fragrance Fills the Garden
records.text: Jasmine talismans hit every enemy for 150% ATK and apply Karmic Mark for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and Body Shatter on every enemy for 1 turn.

records.name: Neat Hand
records.text: +15% accuracy, so her debuffs land more often.

records.name: Song of the Jasmine
records.text: Once per turn, when she lands a debuff, the team gains 1 Spirit Qi.

records.name: Peachwood Charm
records.text: A peachwood charm hits one enemy for 100% ATK, +30% against Yin enemies.

records.name: Door God's Ward
records.text: Door-god charms hit every enemy for 60% ATK, remove one buff from each, and have a 50% chance to Entangle for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and every ally gains Clear Heart for 1 turn.

records.name: Peach Grove Exorcism
records.text: A grove of peachwood swords hits every enemy for 160% ATK, +40% against Yin enemies, and delays their charging techniques by 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and two buffs are removed from every enemy.

records.name: Ward Against Evil
records.text: Every ally gains +15% effect resistance.

records.name: Shentu and Yulei
records.text: At battle start every ally is warded: the first debuff that would land on her is blocked.

records.name: Wave-Treading Talisman
records.text: A rippling talisman hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 35% chance of Qi Disruption for 1 turn.

records.name: Mirror of Still Water
records.text: The pond's mirror hits every enemy for 70% ATK, removes one buff from each and has a 60% chance of Mist Veil for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and the removed buffs pass to your allies.

records.name: Reflection of the Water Immortal
records.text: Waves hit every enemy for 120% ATK and Frost Seal the healthiest one. Then her reflection recasts the previous ally technique of this turn at 60% power; it counts as another card for Kindred Qi.

empower.text: +35% damage and the reflection recasts at full power.

records.name: White Serpent's Calm
records.text: 30% chance to reflect a debuff cast on her back at its caster.

records.name: Reflection
records.text: Kindred Qi counts double for her team: +20% per repeat, up to +45%.

records.name: Morning Sun Talisman
records.text: A blazing talisman hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 35% chance of Fire Poison for 2 turns.

records.name: Golden Crow Seal
records.text: The golden crow's seal hits one enemy for 120% ATK and applies Fire Poison and Withering for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and Fire Poison spreads to every enemy for 2 turns.

records.name: Ten Suns over Fusang
records.text: Ten suns rise: every enemy takes 150% ATK and its charging techniques are delayed by 1 turn, while every ally's charging S2 comes 1 turn closer.

empower.text: +35% damage and Fire Poison on every enemy for 2 turns.

records.name: First Light
records.text: At battle start, every ally's S2 starts 1 turn closer.

records.name: Ten Thousand Dawns
records.text: At battle start, the ally with the lowest max Health gains Phoenix Rebirth: she revives once at 30% health.

records.name: Sorrowless Charm
records.text: A soft talisman hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 25% chance of Lotus Dream for 1 turn.

records.name: Forget-Sorrow Talisman
records.text: Forgetting talismans hit every enemy for 60% ATK with a 50% chance to Seal Meridians for 1 turn; the ally with the most debuffs forgets one.

empower.text: +35% damage and Sealed Meridians lands on every enemy.

records.name: Mother's Hall
records.text: Every enemy takes 150% ATK and its charging techniques are delayed by 1 turn; every ally loses one debuff.

empower.text: +35% damage and a 50% chance of Lotus Dream on every enemy for 1 turn.

records.name: Grass of Forgetting
records.text: She deals 20% more damage to enemies under Lotus Dream or Sealed Meridians.

records.name: A Mother's Worry
records.text: When an ally drops below 30% health, she removes its debuffs and gives it a Spirit Shield worth 60% of her Attack, once per ally per battle.

records.name: Moonsteel Petal
records.text: A falling moonsteel petal hits one enemy for 100% ATK, ignoring 15% of its Defense.

records.name: Wu Gang's Endless Axe
records.text: The axe that can never fell the moon tree falls on every enemy for 70% ATK. Each cast this battle makes it 10% stronger, up to +50%.

empower.text: +35% damage and Body Shatter on every enemy for 1 turn.

records.name: The Cold Palace Descends
records.text: The Guanghan Palace's moonlight falls on every enemy for 170% ATK and applies Karmic Mark for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and her jade rabbit's elixir heals every ally for 50% ATK.

records.name: Fragrance Beyond the Clouds
records.text: Her area techniques gain +15% critical chance.

records.name: Moon Palace Solitude
records.text: She ignores Harmony: her casts neither break nor extend a chain, and she deals 20% more damage.

records.name: Apricot Rain
records.text: Three drops of spring rain hit one enemy for 34% ATK each.

records.name: Thunder Wakes the Insects
records.text: Spring thunder hits every enemy twice for 36% ATK each, with a 40% chance to Entangle for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and Apricot Rain is ready again.

records.name: Apricot Blossom Village
records.text: A spring storm hits every enemy three times for 57% ATK each and leaves them tipsy with Mist Veil for 2 turns. Every ally gains Wind Step for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% damage and Qi Disruption on every enemy for 2 turns.

records.name: Spring Bustles on the Branch
records.text: Each enemy her area techniques hit gives her 2 Haste for the rest of the battle, up to 30.

records.name: Spring Thunder
records.text: Once per turn, when her technique extends a Harmony chain, thunder strikes every enemy once more for 30% ATK.

records.name: Snowline Petal
records.text: A frozen petal hits one enemy for 100% ATK. 25% chance to Frost Seal it for 1 turn.

records.name: Tianshan Blizzard
records.text: A blizzard hits every enemy for 70% ATK, with a 25% chance each to Frost Seal for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and the healthiest enemy is surely Frost Sealed.

records.name: Thousand-Year Snow Lotus
records.text: The snow lotus blooms: every enemy takes 170% ATK, +30% if Frost Sealed, and every ally recovers 40% ATK.

empower.text: +35% damage and healing, and a 40% chance to Frost Seal each enemy for 1 turn.

records.name: Cold Purity
records.text: Once per turn, when a Frost Seal she applied breaks, the team gains 1 Spirit Qi.

records.name: Blooms Once in Sixty Years
records.text: When she falls, each enemy has a 50% chance to be Frost Sealed for 1 turn and every ally recovers 15% health.

records.name: Climbing Stone
records.text: A climbing stone spike hits one enemy for 100% ATK.

records.name: Pillar to the Clouds
records.text: Stone pillars burst under every enemy for 70% ATK, and she climbs one: Iron Body for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and a 25% chance of Soul Shock on each enemy for 1 turn.

records.name: Soaring Over the Empyrean
records.text: She rides a rising mountain into the sky and brings it down on every enemy for 170% ATK, with a 50% chance of Body Shatter for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% damage and Body Shatter always lands.

records.name: Borrowed Height
records.text: +15% damage while she has a buff.

records.name: Reach the Clouds
records.text: Her ultimate gives 2 more Phase Qi to the phase she feeds.

records.name: Eastern Fence Needle
records.text: Two acupuncture needles hit one enemy for 50% ATK each. The most injured ally recovers 70% ATK.

records.name: Chrysanthemum Tea
records.text: Every ally recovers 90% ATK and loses one debuff.

empower.text: +35% healing and Sword Intent for every ally for 1 turn.

records.name: Double Ninth Longevity
records.text: Every ally recovers 80% ATK and gains Sword Intent for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% healing and Clear Heart for every ally for 1 turn.

records.name: Defying Frost
records.text: Allies she heals gain +10% critical chance for 1 turn.

records.name: Prolonging Years
records.text: Once per battle, when an ally drops below 30% health, she heals it for 120% ATK.

records.name: Lily Bulb Remedy
records.text: A lily dart hits one enemy for 90% ATK. The most injured ally recovers 65% ATK.

records.name: Hundred Years in Harmony
records.text: Every ally recovers 85% ATK and gains Lotus Dew for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% healing and Wind Step for every ally for 2 turns.

records.name: Red Thread Bloom
records.text: Every ally recovers 100% ATK, loses one debuff and gains Wind Step for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% healing and two more debuffs are removed from every ally.

records.name: Matchmaker's Eye
records.text: Her healing is 20% stronger when her cast extends a Harmony chain.

records.name: A Hundred Years Together
records.text: At battle start, every ally gains Lotus Dew for 2 turns.

records.name: Five-Colour Petals
records.text: Two petals hit one enemy for 50% ATK each. The most injured ally recovers 70% ATK.

records.name: Changing Soil
records.text: Every ally recovers 90% ATK and gains a buff that follows her current phase for 1 turn: Metal Sword Intent, Wood Wind Step, Water Lotus Dew, Fire Surging Qi, Earth Iron Body.

empower.text: +35% healing and every ally loses one debuff.

records.name: Embroidered Ball of Five Colours
records.text: Every ally recovers 100% ATK, and the tossed embroidered ball gives the most injured ally Phoenix Rebirth for 2 turns.

empower.text: +35% healing and every ally gains her current phase's buff for 2 turns.

records.name: Rain-Season Bloom
records.text: When she heals an ally below half health, it also gains Lotus Dew for 1 turn.

records.name: Shifting Colours
records.text: Her techniques take the phase that extends the current chain, as hydrangeas change colour with their soil. The borrowed phase also sets her advantage and Phase Qi.

records.name: Rouge Strike
records.text: A rouge-red palm hits one enemy for 90% ATK. The most injured ally recovers 60% ATK.

records.name: Quicken the Blood
records.text: Every ally recovers 80% ATK, and the ally with the highest Attack gains Surging Qi for 1 turn.

empower.text: +35% healing and Surging Qi for every ally for 1 turn.

records.name: Red Flower Cautery
records.text: She spends 10% of her health: every ally recovers 110% ATK and loses two debuffs.

empower.text: +35% healing and the most injured ally gains Phoenix Rebirth for 2 turns.

records.name: Hot Blood
records.text: Her healing also removes Fire Poison and Gu Venom from the ally she heals.

records.name: A Little Rouge
records.text: At battle start, every ally gains Surging Qi for 1 turn.
